checks.text: The page displays the heading "Password Manager" and, when no entries exist, shows the text "No entries yet".

Clicking the button "New entry" opens a form. Typing "GitHub" in the field labelled "Name", "octocat" in the field labelled "Username", and "secret123" in the field labelled "Password", then clicking "Save" adds a list item containing "GitHub" and "octocat". The text "No entries yet" is no longer visible.

In the entry list, clicking the button "Reveal" next to the "GitHub" entry changes the password field display from "••••••••••" to "secret123". Clicking "Reveal" again changes it back to "••••••••••".

Clicking the button "Generate" next to the "GitHub" entry replaces the password with a new 12-character string. The new password contains at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.
Clicking the button "Copy" next to the "GitHub" entry copies the current password to the clipboard and displays a toast message "Copied to clipboard".
Typing "git" in the search box labelled "Search" filters the list to show only the "GitHub" entry. Typing "nonexistent" in the search box shows the text "No entries match".
Clicking the button "Delete" next to the "GitHub" entry removes the item from the list. The list becomes empty and the text "No entries yet" is visible again.
After adding an entry named "GitHub" with password "secret123", reloading the page still shows the list item containing "GitHub" and "octocat". Clicking "Reveal" shows "secret123".

In the "New entry" form, selecting "Passphrase" in the select labelled "Type" and clicking "Generate" produces a password consisting of 4 words separated by hyphens, such as "correct-horse-battery-staple".
